articles.title: Flyers Activate Barkey Off IR; Place Grebenkin on IR
Nuts & Bolts: Lightning host Caps in home opener

away.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers are coming off a 3-2 overtime loss to the New Jersey Devils, where Joseph Woll delivered an outstanding goaltending performance. The team is facing challenges with puck possession and shot quality, and they are playing their fourth game in six nights. They are also missing key players due to injuries, but Barkey is expected to return for the road trip starting with the Tampa Bay Lightning.

home.summary: The Tampa Bay Lightning are coming off a 3-1 home win against the Washington Capitals, with Andrei Vasilevskiy making 20 saves. The team is in good form, but they are missing several players due to injuries, including defenseman Emil Lilleberg. The Lightning are looking to maintain their strong start to the season against the Flyers.
